GremlinNob: Turn 1 Bellow gives it Enrage 2: every Skill you play gives it 2 Strength for the rest of the fight. Then it mostly alternates Rush (14) and Skull Bash (6 and 2 Vulnerable). Play as few Skills as you can and race it with attacks.
Lagavulin: Starts asleep with Metallicize 8 (8 block every turn). It wakes after 3 turns, or as soon as an attack damages its HP, and is stunned for the turn it is woken that way. Awake, it uses Attack (one hit of 18) on two turns in a row, then Siphon Soul on the third (you lose 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity), and repeats. Use its sleeping turns to play powers and set up; once awake, block the 18s.
Sentry: Three Sentries, each with 1 Artifact. Each alternates Bolt (adds 2 unplayable Dazed to your deck for this fight) and Beam (9 damage); the middle one is out of step with the outer two, so some damage comes every turn. Kill an outer Sentry first.
SlimeBoss: 140 HP. It repeats Goop Spray (3 Slimed into your discard pile), Preparing, then Slam (35). When its HP falls to 70 or less it splits into an Acid Slime (L) and a Spike Slime (L), each starting with the boss's current HP. The split cannot be avoided, so never hold back damage to delay it: deal as much as you can on the turn it crosses 70 so the two Large slimes start low, and block Slam.
TheGuardian: 240 HP with two modes. Offensive mode: Charging Up (gains 9 block), Fierce Bash (32), Vent Steam (2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable on you), Whirlwind (5x4). After you deal 30 damage to it (40 the next time, then 50) it shifts to Defensive Mode: it gains 20 block and Sharp Hide 3 (you take 3 damage for every Attack you play), uses Roll Attack (9) and Twin Slam (8x2), then returns to offensive mode. While Sharp Hide is up, prefer Skills and few, large attacks.
Hexaghost: 250 HP. Turn 1 Activate does nothing. Turn 2 Divider hits 6 times for (your current HP / 12, rounded down) + 1 each. Afterwards it cycles Sear (6 and a Burn into your discard pile), Tackle (5x2), Inflame (gains 2 Strength and 12 block) and Inferno (2x6, and upgrades every Burn). A Burn in hand at the end of your turn deals 2 damage to you. Block Divider and Inferno.
AcidSlime_L: When its HP falls to half its max HP or less, its next move is Split: it is replaced by two Acid Slime (M), each with the HP it has at that moment. Holding back damage never avoids the split; it only lengthens the fight. Damage dealt after it crosses half and before its turn still lowers both Acid Slime (M), and killing it before its turn prevents the split, so deal as much as you can on that turn.
SpikeSlime_L: When its HP falls to half its max HP or less, its next move is Split: it is replaced by two Spike Slime (M), each with the HP it has at that moment. Holding back damage never avoids the split; it only lengthens the fight. Damage dealt after it crosses half and before its turn still lowers both Spike Slime (M), and killing it before its turn prevents the split, so deal as much as you can on that turn.
